=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: PR description states "implement.yml" stages `ai_engine.sh` and `claude_engine.py`, and separately stages `claude_settings.json.tmpl`. The PR description also states "The file is 316,278 bytes, under the §27 guard" and "Tests (G4)" include regression coverage that asserts the new staging in the workflow.
  Expected change site: `scripts/check_workflow_script_refs.py` lines 43-47 — the `EXPLICIT_REF`, `SCRIPTS_VAR_REF` and `BARE_NAME` regexes' allowed-extension list.
  Evidence of absence: No diff hunk in `scripts/check_workflow_script_refs.py` adds `tmpl` to the `(?:sh|py|json|txt|md)` extension list. The CI `static-checks` log on PR head `6faff73fe561a5dba8e5b802ee2f5925b70d11d6` reports `FAIL: implement.yml: references scripts/claude_settings.json which does not exist` and the same for `plan.yml`. The check's regex `EXPLICIT_REF = re.compile(r"scripts/([a-zA-Z0-9_.\-]+\.(?:sh|py|json|txt|md))")` matches `scripts/claude_settings.json` from the staged path `scripts/claude_settings.json.tmpl`, then fails the existence check because the template is named `.json.tmpl`. Both the LAST RUN DIFF and the PR DIFF introduce literal `scripts/claude_settings.json.tmpl` references in `implement.yml` (lines 1043-1054) and `plan.yml` (lines 296-306), but the checker that gates merges on them was not updated.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: PR description states the `IMPLEMENT_REPAIR` role in `implement.yml` and `scripts/codex_thread_reuse.sh` "resumes the role's Claude session across attempts the way it resumes a codex thread" at each role's existing reasoning level.
  Expected change site: `.github/workflows/implement.yml` lines 4037-4044 (the "Attempt post-Codex syntax repair" launch block) — must set `AI_ENGINE_EFFORT_HINT` from `MODEL_REPAIR_REASONING_EFFORT` so the Claude repair branch uses the repair-specific effort tier rather than the main `MODEL_REASONING_EFFORT`.
  Evidence of absence: The LAST RUN DIFF and PR DIFF only add `CODEX_THREAD_REUSE_ENGINE` and `CODEX_THREAD_REUSE_ENGINE_ROLE` to the repair launch — `AI_ENGINE_EFFORT_HINT` is never passed. `scripts/codex_thread_reuse.sh:684` reads `AI_ENGINE_EFFORT_HINT="${AI_ENGINE_EFFORT_HINT:-${MODEL_REASONING_EFFORT:-}}"` for the Claude branch, so the helper falls back to the main implementation effort (`MODEL_REASONING_EFFORT`) when `AI_ENGINE_EFFORT_HINT` is unset. The workflow already exposes `MODEL_REPAIR_REASONING_EFFORT: ${{ vars.THINKING_LEVEL_IMPLEMENT_REPAIR || 'high' }}` at `implement.yml:45`, but the repair launch never threads it through. When `THINKING_LEVEL_IMPLEMENT_REPAIR` is configured to differ from `THINKING_LEVEL_IMPLEMENT` (the canonical separation the agent's documentation expects), Claude repair runs silently ignore the operator-set repair tier.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The PR description states "The codex commands are unchanged" and "the unchanged codex call" is preserved across both Phase 5a and 5b. The "Tests (G4)" section promises regression checks for both the Claude branch and the "unchanged codex call".
  Expected change site: CI green is a load-bearing release invariant; the `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` check-run reports `5 failed, 171 passed in 6.93s` on PR head `6faff73fe561a5dba8e5b802ee2f5925b70d11d6` (per `pr_check_runs_context.txt`). The specific failing test names are not visible in the truncated log tail.
  Evidence of absence: No change in the LAST RUN DIFF addresses the `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` failure; the autofix editor's own summary explicitly states "The failed `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` check remains unresolved… the root hook is absent from this checkout, so the reported five failures cannot be safely mapped to a fix here." A successful PR requires the green status of every CI needs-jobs (`tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` is one of them per the `lint` aggregate at `ci.yml`). The LAST RUN DIFF therefore leaves a load-bearing CI check unresolved on the PR head.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
